Here, we run the MOVICS pipeline (see [here](https://xlucpu.github.io/MOVICS/MOVICS-VIGNETTE.html)) using the default parameters. When identifying the optimal number of clusters $k$, we try for $k \in \{`r params[["hyperparameters"]][["min_k"]]`, \ldots, `r params[["hyperparameters"]][["max_k"]]`\}$. All algorithms are run with default parameters, apart from ``iClusterBayes`` where we set ``n.burnin = `r params[["hyperparameters"]][["n_burnin"]]` `` and ``n.draw = `r params[["hyperparameters"]][["n_draw"]]` ``, to reduce running times. The consensus multi-omic clustering algorithm is run for the optimal $k$ only.
